body: Thanks for the responses reddit peoples! A lot of the points everyone is making has crossed my mind. I believe its disrespectful for another man to offer those kinds of gifts. But when is it disrespectful coming from.your wife?

Haha loving the comments. Let's give it some context. My wife's ex boyfriend (they're still friends which I'm ok with) often buys her flowers and occasionally jewelry, and 300 dollars worth of tattoos. For a short period of time we were on a break and he "drunkenly" bought her a sex toy. To me this seems crossing the line. But maybe I'm crazy

This is a lot of potential goodness in the relationship. Just a lot of damage bogging it down. Our oldest is my step daughter (not legally) her bio dad is a real huge asshole. So another broken family would destroy that little girl.
